facts.fact: Developing Telecoms reported on 2026-08-13 that the FDSU unveiled a National Connectivity Strategy 2026-2035 with a 2030 target of 3,000 localities and 16 million people, and that further consultations with stakeholders are planned as it is refined; no government adoption is stated.

The FDSU signed subsidy agreements with Airtel, Orange, Vodacom and Africell for 10 localities each (40 localities, about 258,000 people) as the first step of the National Connectivity Strategy 2026-2035, per Developing Telecoms citing Ecofin; published 2026-08-13, signing date not given.
